import numpy as np,cv2,pandas as pd
from mobile_sam import sam_model_registry,SamPredictor
im=cv2.cvtColor(cv2.imread('demo_rgb.png'),cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB);g=cv2.cvtColor(im,cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY).astype(float)
m=sam_model_registry['vit_t'](checkpoint='mobile_sam.pt').eval();p=SamPredictor(m);p.set_image(im)
o=pd.read_csv('demo_metadata.csv')
for i in [0,6,5,17]:
  r=o.loc[i];b=np.array([r.xmin,r.ymin,r.xmax,r.ymax],float)
  ms,s,_=p.predict(box=b,multimask_output=True)
  ba=(b[2]-b[0]+1)*(b[3]-b[1]+1)
  for k in range(3):
    mk=ms[k];ring=cv2.dilate(mk.astype(np.uint8),np.ones((7,7)))>0
    ring&=~mk
    print(i,r.type,k,round(float(s[k]),3),round(mk.sum()/ba,2),round(g[ring].mean()-g[mk].mean(),1))
"
